failure_rules: Apply unchanged FG six-rank precedence, not a new success category.
Missing independent origin before start: BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE unless a higher rank applies.
Known wrong identity/role/source: BINDING_REJECTED unless a higher rank applies.
Consumed or ambiguous role allowance: ALREADY_CONSUMED, no new child, unless completion uncertainty ranks higher.
After attempted creation, unknown required identity/adoption/exit/closure cannot succeed; terminal-owner or closure uncertainty is COMPLETION_UNCONFIRMED.
Preserve acquired handles, original primary and cleanup errors; no retry or invented identity.
Not-yet-required pre-start close is not an actual failed close.

source_observations.observation: Current pipe-parent check and full initial payload reading do not provide the specified independently rooted pre-input expectation.
Persisted handoff validation and per-instance attempted roles do not implement the specified independent shared live role allowance.
Actual child handle adoption exists; it does not replace admission of the independent caller or caller-observed final observer completion.
